annotations.title: Upload an in-app event's picture or video

description: Uploads the event card (slot card: 16:9, 1920×1080 to 3840×2160) or details page (slot details: 9:16, 1080×1920 to 2160×3840) media of one language of an event: a PNG or JPEG picture, or a MOV, M4V or MP4 video (30 or 60 fps), from an absolute path on this machine. It replaces the one there was. The language's text must be saved first (ploa_event_save). No text or logos in the media, no borders or gradients: Apple adds those. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

path.description: Absolute path to the picture or video.
